scope: Offline correlation by actual response request ID; no timing rerun or additional requests. Diagnostic overhead means not acceptance. NodeGC timestamps use the same Node performance clock as request/context spans. Process CPU/ELU/memory are aggregate, overlapping read sums and inclusive memo phases cannot be added as disjoint wall.

phaseDefinitions.contextMs: Wall around unchanged loadProjectContext, including diagnostic callbacks; ends before context summary serialization.
phaseDefinitions.requestSyncMs: Index/projection/JSON work after context in request ALS scope.
phaseDefinitions.memo.total: Inclusive lookup/compare/LRU/parser(ifmiss)/cloning/accounting; contains other memo phase durations.
phaseDefinitions.callbackSumMs: Sum of per-read admission→callback elapsed;64concurrent reads overlap and JS/event-loop delays are included. Not disk wall.
phaseDefinitions.queueSumMs: Sum enqueue→admission wait; overlapping by design.
phaseDefinitions.gcOverlapMs: Interval overlap with globally timestamped GC entries; correlation, not exclusive causal attribution.
phaseDefinitions.processCpu: Process-wide user/system aggregate across threads; not request-exclusive if overlap.
phaseDefinitions.browserRequestToResponseStart: Browser ResourceTiming responseStart−requestStart, includes network/server wait; no standalone server-only TTFB claim.
